name: mirage
text: Done: (1) games can now start within 1 minute of the quote (was 20; in-play games still decline because their odds move too fast to price); (2) the paper-only pairs of two player props from one game are now quoted live (that was 28% of requests). Stake, collateral caps and the 20% premium per prop leg are unchanged. I left ONE paper feature off: the model-priced quote path (marketPricing). Its own go-live rule says the first live parlays must not be below -$3 per $100 of collateral, and they are at -$26 on about $60. If you want that live anyway, say 'marketPricing live' and I'll switch it. Remaining blocker is 32% of requests with two legs in one game that aren't side+total or two props; I'm looking at which shapes those are.
